title: Three damage-element vocabularies disagree: canon Cold, profile ice, 33/70 spells off-set
body:
## Summary
PoF states its damage elements three different ways: the canon law, the profile element set and the spellbook seed.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/canon/canon-seed.ts:44 (arpg-damage-model) lists Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Chaos. src/lib/catalog/canon/elements.ts:16 pins pof = fire, ice, lightning, chaos (the set Resistances steps grade against). The spellbook seed (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/_shared/data.ts:785, surfaced by src/lib/catalog/seed-spellbook.ts:10 as categoryPath) uses Fire, Ice, Lightning, Shadow, Holy, Physical, Arcane, Nature. Per design-canon-as-executable-law (one statement per rule; point the linter at your own shipped defaults first) one of these must be the law and the others derived or flagged.

## Flow
- produce prompt for a spellbook entity cites arpg-damage-model (Cold) while the entity's element is Ice or Shadow
- Resistances grading uses elementsOf('pof') = ice, never cold
- fix: decide the canonical set, rewrite the canon body, then add a test that every spellbook element is in elementsOf('pof') (or an explicit non-damage allow-list)

## Expected impact
Designers and the LLM producer stop receiving contradictory element names; a judge can grade element use. Risk: re-elementing 33 spells is a content change visible in the spellbook UI.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one element vocabulary across canon, profile and seed
Before: 3 vocabularies; 'Cold' vs 'ice' naming split; 33 of 70 spells (Shadow 10, Holy 9, Arcane 9, Nature 5) carry an element outside elementsOf('pof')
After: 1 vocabulary, 0 off-set spells (or an explicit allow-list), pinned by a test
Method: probe - counted spellbook elements via a throwaway vitest probe over seedSpellbookEntries(); the fix itself is a content decision
Result: better
Gate: direction

title: Weathered Stone seed breaks the art-material law (separate roughness, no ORM)
body:
## Summary
The only seeded material does not satisfy the canon law its own prompts cite.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/canon/canon-seed.ts:13 (art-material) says 'Albedo/Normal/ORM are required maps'. src/lib/catalog/seed-materials.ts:38-43 seeds textures albedo, normal, roughness, detailNormal - no ORM, roughness as a standalone map. Either the law should allow separate channels, or the seed (and build_weathered_stone.py) should pack ORM.

## Flow
- materials produce prompt carries art-material (ORM required)
- the code seed it is graded beside has no ORM
- fix: operator picks law or seed; add a test pinning the seed's texture keys against the law

## Expected impact
The material pipeline's own exemplar stops contradicting its canon. Risk: changing the seed changes the UE MI build parameters.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - seeded exemplar conforms to its canon
Before: 1 of 1 seeded materials lacks the ORM map the law requires
After: 0 of 1, pinned
Method: probe - read both statements; which side moves is a direction call
Result: better
Gate: direction
evidence:
src/lib/catalog/canon/canon-seed.ts:13 'Albedo/Normal/ORM are required maps'
src/lib/catalog/seed-materials.ts:38-43 textures: { albedo, normal, roughness, detailNormal }

title: Darth Malgrave's stats claim to mirror bestiary-sith-lord but no in-tree source holds 50/12/3
body:
## Summary
Malgrave's attribute block says it MIRRORS the bestiary-sith-lord Stat Block, but the tree's Stat Block and archetype say otherwise.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/seed-characters.ts:92-101 sets health 50, attackPower 12, characterLevel 3 and states 'If the archetype moves, this row is what has to move with it'. In tree: the bestiary Stat Block produce (src/lib/catalog/pipelines/bestiary.ts:122-137) writes health 420 / damage 35 / monsterLevel 20 for every entity, and the archetype (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/_shared/data-expanded.ts:314-318) carries HP 82 / ATK 70 normalized. The mirror is against a DB artifact or nothing; no test can see drift.

## Flow
- read the comment's claim
- grep the tree for the 50/12/3 source: none
- fix: decide the canonical source (a duel-tuning constant both rows import, or the stored Stat Block) and pin Malgrave to it

## Expected impact
The duel boss's numbers get one statement. Risk: changing the numbers moves the browser duel balance.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one source for the duel boss's stats
Before: 3 numbers stated only in seed-characters.ts; 0 in-tree sources match; 0 tests
After: 1 shared source, pinned
Method: probe - grep for the values across src/lib/catalog and sub_bestiary
Result: better
Gate: direction
evidence:
src/lib/catalog/seed-characters.ts:92-101 health: 50 ... attackPower: 12 ... characterLevel: 3
src/lib/catalog/pipelines/bestiary.ts:131-137 health: 420, damage: 35, monsterLevel: 20
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/_shared/data-expanded.ts:314 sith-lord hp: 82, atk: 70

title: Audio and animation-assets sections ship empty seeds with no pipeline since Phase 8b
body:
## Summary
Two registered CATALOG_SECTIONS seed nothing and have no pipeline, so they are lab rows with no entity and no walk.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/seed-audio.ts:8 and src/lib/catalog/seed-animation-assets.ts:9 return [] ('until Phase 10 lifts real data'); src/lib/catalog/sections.ts:39-40 registers them. Probe: sections-without-pipeline = ['audio','animation-assets']. src/lib/catalog/pipelines/vfx.ts:126,146 already works around the empty audio catalog by dropping links. Decide: lift real data, or retire both sections.

## Flow
- open the lab -> Audio / Animation Assets -> no entity
- vfx pipeline cannot link a sound (vfx.ts:146)
- fix: operator decision (seed or remove)

## Expected impact
Removes two empty rows or makes them useful; vfx gains a link target. Risk: removal touches sections.ts consumers.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no permanently empty registered catalog
Before: 2 sections, 0 entities, 0 pipelines
After: 0 empty sections
Method: probe - throwaway vitest probe diffing CATALOG_SECTIONS vs allCatalogPipelines()
Result: better
Gate: direction

title: Custom-archetype steps get the full canon by an unmapped key, not by decision
body:
## Summary
ARCHETYPE_CANON has no 'custom' key, so the 5 custom steps fall through to undefined and receive every canon category.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/canon/archetypeCanon.ts:11-20 maps 8 archetypes; pipelines use 9 (probe: 'custom' missing). src/lib/catalog/contractPrompt.ts:263 returns ARCHETYPE_CANON[spec.archetype] -> undefined -> selectRules takes all categories (src/lib/catalog/canon/canonContext.ts:4). Affected: src/lib/catalog/pipelines/character-pipeline.ts:231,257,310,352 and src/lib/catalog/pipelines/player-movement.ts:137. Whether they should carry art+game+project or a slice is unmeasured.

## Flow
- buildStepProducePrompt for a custom step -> canonCategoriesForStep undefined -> all categories
- instrument: build the 5 prompts with undefined vs an explicit slice, count canon rules/chars, judge-sample one
- then add 'custom' explicitly and a test that every used archetype has a key

## Expected impact
Custom-step prompts carry a decided canon slice; a future archetype cannot silently fall through. Risk: narrowing drops laws those steps rely on.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every archetype's canon slice is decided
Before: 1 of 9 used archetypes unmapped; 5 steps get the full canon implicitly
After: 9 of 9 mapped, pinned; prompt-size delta measured
Method: simulation - walked src/lib/catalog/contractPrompt.ts:263 for the 5 steps; prompt-size figure not taken (needs the prompt-builder harness)
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: build the 5 custom-step prompts via buildStepProducePrompt with undefined vs ['project'] and vs ['art','project'], count canon rules and chars; add a used-archetype coverage test

title: Stale rule: catalog-pipeline.md still says player-movement is absent from CATALOG_SECTIONS
body:
## Summary
The always-loaded catalog-pipeline rule names a gap that no longer exists.

## Description
.claude/rules/catalog-pipeline.md:61 says 'player-movement is registered but absent from CATALOG_SECTIONS, so the lab surfaces no entity'. src/lib/catalog/new-catalogs.ts:111-112 seeds player-locomotion-manny and the probe shows pipelines-without-section = []. Every session working in catalog paths loads this stale instruction.

## Flow
- read the rule line
- probe pipelines vs sections: 0 missing
- fix: drop the parenthetical

## Expected impact
Agents stop chasing a closed gap. Risk: none.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - rule text matches the registry
Before: 1 stale claim in an auto-loaded rule; 0 pipelines actually lack a section
After: 0 stale claims
Method: probe - throwaway vitest probe over allCatalogPipelines() vs CATALOG_SECTIONS
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
.claude/rules/catalog-pipeline.md:61 '(Current documented gap: `player-movement` is registered but absent from `CATALOG_SECTIONS` ...)'
src/lib/catalog/new-catalogs.ts:111 catalogId: 'player-movement' ... starters: [{ id: 'player-locomotion-manny' ...
probe: pipelines not sections = []
instrument: out-of-scope (rule file outside this context's paths): re-run the pipelines-vs-sections diff, then edit the line

title: ARPG-LAWS refs '#1'..'#12' resolve to no markdown heading anchor
body:
## Summary
20 canon refs point at docs/catalog/ARPG-LAWS.md#<n>, and none of those anchors exist.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/canon/canon-seed.ts:41-60 carries refs like 'docs/catalog/ARPG-LAWS.md#1'. The file exists, but its headings are '## 1. Item Rarity & Item Level' etc. (docs/catalog/ARPG-LAWS.md:16-231), whose slugs are '#1-item-rarity--item-level', not '#1'. The refs are rendered into prompts (src/lib/catalog/canon/canonContext.ts:15) and the editor. Changing them changes canonTextHash, so every untouched project_rules row becomes a 'follow' in canon sync - the instrument must count that.

## Flow
- resolve a ref -> lands at the top of the doc, not the section
- fix: rewrite refs to real slugs (or section prose); measure the canon-sync plan: follow count == rewritten rules, conflicts 0

## Expected impact
Refs become auditable backwards (design-canon-as-executable-law 'refs' field). Risk: a sync wave over 20 rows.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - canon refs resolve
Before: 20 refs, 0 resolve to a heading anchor
After: 20 of 20 resolve; canon-sync plan shows 20 follow, 0 conflict
Method: probe - existsSync on the file (true) and read its headings; sync impact not measured
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/lib/catalog/canon/canon-seed.ts:41 refs: ['docs/catalog/ARPG-LAWS.md#1']
docs/catalog/ARPG-LAWS.md:16 '## 1. Item Rarity & Item Level'
instrument: rewrite the 20 refs to heading slugs, then run planCanonSync over a copy of project_rules and count follow/conflict verdicts
